evidenceDecision: Real snapshot tests exercise retirement during construction, expired catalogue scheduling, failed-host stale topology and healthy sibling publication with bounded synthetic transports. Fresh Desk observation callbacks run once at successful host admission with the read-start time; cache reuse, invalidation and retirement never replay those observations. Observation v1 adds bounded base admission and/or incremental consumer evidence; historical acceptance remains scoped to the existing models and consumers. M1/P6 additions require independent candidate review. Service scheduling progress and Q12/Q13 transport claims are unchanged. Host grouping is a read-only projection over unchanged per-runtime observations. Sixteen two-runtime lifecycle combinations check independent actionability/staleness; a real snapshot cache consumer retains a failed sibling generation while a healthy runtime stays actionable. No host identity grants authority or changes scheduling bounds. A stopped manual scheduler cannot hold snapshot construction: the task-turn port admits native I/O without advancing elapsed time. A controlled construction turn verifies lease retirement before projection; the real snapshot consumer checks this scheduling boundary without changing the modeled admission states.
